verses.greek: Πρεσβυτέρους οὖν ἐν ὑμῖν παρακαλῶ ὁ συμπρεσβύτερος καὶ μάρτυς τῶν τοῦ Χριστοῦ παθημάτων, ὁ καὶ τῆς μελλούσης ἀποκαλύπτεσθαι δόξης κοινωνός,
verses.literal: Elders therefore among you I exhort the a fellow elder and witness of the the of Christ sufferings who am also of the being about to be revealed glory a partaker
verses.dgt: Therefore I urge the elders among you, as a fellow elder and witness of the sufferings of Christ and also a sharer in the glory that is about to be revealed:

verses.greek: ποιμάνατε τὸ ἐν ὑμῖν ποίμνιον τοῦ θεοῦ, ἐπισκοποῦντες μὴ ἀναγκαστῶς ἀλλὰ ἑκουσίως κατὰ θεόν, μηδὲ αἰσχροκερδῶς ἀλλὰ προθύμως,
verses.literal: do shepherd the among you flock the of God exercising oversight not under compulsion but willingly according to God and not for base gain but eagerly
verses.dgt: shepherd the flock of God among you, exercising oversight not under compulsion but willingly, according to God, not for shameful gain but eagerly,

verses.greek: μηδʼ ὡς κατακυριεύοντες τῶν κλήρων ἀλλὰ τύποι γινόμενοι τοῦ ποιμνίου·
verses.literal: not as exercising lordship over the those in your charge but examples being to the flock
verses.dgt: not lording it over those allotted to you, but becoming examples to the flock.

verses.greek: καὶ φανερωθέντος τοῦ ἀρχιποίμενος κομιεῖσθε τὸν ἀμαράντινον τῆς δόξης στέφανον.
verses.literal: And when was being revealed the Chief Shepherd you will receive the unfading the of glory crown.
verses.dgt: And when the Chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the unfading crown of glory.

verses.greek: ὁμοίως, νεώτεροι, ὑποτάγητε πρεσβυτέροις. πάντες δὲ ἀλλήλοις τὴν ταπεινοφροσύνην ἐγκομβώσασθε, ὅτι Ὁ θεὸς ὑπερηφάνοις ἀντιτάσσεται ταπεινοῖς δὲ δίδωσιν χάριν.
verses.literal: Likewise younger ones do be subjected to your elders All now to one another the humility do gird on because the God the proud opposes to the humble however He gives grace.
verses.dgt: Likewise, younger ones, be subject to elders. And all of you clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because “God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.”

verses.greek: Ταπεινώθητε οὖν ὑπὸ τὴν κραταιὰν χεῖρα τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα ὑμᾶς ὑψώσῃ ἐν καιρῷ,
verses.literal: do be humbled therefore under the mighty hand the of God so that you He may exalt in due time
verses.dgt: Therefore humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, so that he may exalt you at the proper time,

verses.greek: πᾶσαν τὴν μέριμναν ὑμῶν ἐπιρίψαντες ἐπʼ αὐτόν, ὅτι αὐτῷ μέλει περὶ ὑμῶν.
verses.literal: all the anxiety of you having cast upon Him because with Him there is care about you.
verses.dgt: casting all your anxiety on him, because he cares for you.

verses.greek: νήψατε, γρηγορήσατε. ὁ ἀντίδικος ὑμῶν διάβολος ὡς λέων ὠρυόμενος περιπατεῖ ζητῶν τινα καταπιεῖν·
verses.literal: do be sober-minded do watch The adversary of You the devil as a lion roaring he prowls about seeking whom to devour
verses.dgt: Be sober; be watchful. Your adversary the devil walks around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.

verses.greek: ᾧ ἀντίστητε στερεοὶ τῇ πίστει, εἰδότες τὰ αὐτὰ τῶν παθημάτων τῇ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ὑμῶν ἀδελφότητι ἐπιτελεῖσθαι.
verses.literal: whom do resist firm in the faith knowing the same the sufferings the throughout the world in your brotherhood is being accomplished.
verses.dgt: Resist him, firm in the faith, knowing that the same kinds of sufferings are being accomplished by your brotherhood in the world.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ θεὸς πάσης χάριτος, ὁ καλέσας ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν αἰώνιον αὐτοῦ δόξαν ἐν Χριστῷ, ὀλίγον παθόντας αὐτὸς καταρτίσει, στηρίξει, σθενώσει, θεμελιώσει.
verses.literal: The now God of all grace the one having called you to the eternal of Him glory in Christ a little while of you having suffered He Himself will perfect he will confirm you he will strengthen you and he will establish you.
verses.dgt: And the God of all grace, who called you into his eternal glory in Christ, after you have suffered a little while, will himself restore, establish, strengthen, and firmly ground you.

verses.greek: αὐτῷ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.
verses.literal: To Him be the power to the ages of the ages. Amen..
verses.dgt: To him be the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

verses.greek: Διὰ Σιλουανοῦ ὑμῖν τοῦ πιστοῦ ἀδελφοῦ, ὡς λογίζομαι, διʼ ὀλίγων ἔγραψα, παρακαλῶν καὶ ἐπιμαρτυρῶν ταύτην εἶναι ἀληθῆ χάριν τοῦ θεοῦ· εἰς ἣν στῆτε.
verses.literal: Through Silvanus to you the faithful brother as I regard him through few words I have written exhorting and testifying this to be the true grace the of God in which do stand firm.
verses.dgt: Through Silvanus, the faithful brother as I regard him, I have written to you briefly, urging and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.

verses.greek: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς ἡ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι συνεκλεκτὴ καὶ Μᾶρκος ὁ υἱός μου.
verses.literal: Greets you she in Babylon elected with you and Mark the son of mine.
verses.dgt: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you, and so does Mark my son.

verses.greek: ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν φιλήματι ἀγάπης. εἰρήνη ὑμῖν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ.
verses.literal: do greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to you all who are in Christ
verses.dgt: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
